verdict: The "p1 pad lost" alert is a small amber tag floating in mid-screen between the storm hint and the walls. It is easy to miss, it has no glyph, and it sits beside several other floating tags, so the HUD reads as a pile of pills, not one clear layer.

findings.where: "p1 pad lost" tag, centre of screen at about (960,285)
findings.what: This is the key alert on the screen. It is a small 20px amber pill on the busy tan map, with no icon and no pulse. Nothing separates it from the "running slowly" and "extract 133m" pills above it. It does not name the recovery action (press a button to rejoin). Amber is the old warn colour and is close to the map's brown, so contrast is weak.
findings.fix: Make it one dark --ui-panel card with a 3px --warn left bar, 32px f-cond title "p1 pad lost" in tx-1, and a 16px --tx-2 line "reconnect pad" below. Centre it at y≈30% with a 90ms bounce-in. Keep the pad glyph at 24px in --warn.

findings.where: Stack of pills in the top centre: team score, extract 133m, running slowly, p1 pad lost
findings.what: Four to five separate labels sit in the middle column at different widths. Their fills and radii differ (the team score panel is square-ish, the pills are round). They have no shared left edge and no 8px rhythm: gaps run from 8px to 70px. The team score panel (about 300x100) also overlaps the top map edge.
findings.fix: Put them in one centred column of equal-width cards (280px) with 8px gaps and --rad 4px. Give all the same fill, #16191b at 90%, and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Put alerts below status and use one fixed font size, 20px.

findings.where: Faded line "storm · lightning shows you from farther off" at y≈245
findings.what: This is an explaining sentence at about 40% opacity over the map. It is unreadable (contrast under 2:1), and the style guide bans explaining sentences. It collides with the walls and the pad-lost tag below it.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence. If a storm cue is needed, use the existing "storm" chip at bottom-left only, with 16px text on --ui-panel.

findings.where: Right column: minimap, run info, "extraction c available" tag
findings.what: The run info panel is a heavy block, with a collapse caret and a stack of goal lines at 20px, all one weight and brightness. The "extraction c available" tag floats outside the panel at x≈1700, clipped by the right edge, with a different fill and a teal arrow. The "run goals" heading looks identical to the rows below it. The minimap is cropped at the top and right.
findings.fix: Make the heading 16px tx-2 and the rows 20px tx-1, with the reward "+200 sp" right-aligned in lime. Put the extraction tag inside a 24px-padded card of the same width as run info, 8px below it, and inset the minimap by 24px so it is not clipped.

findings.where: Bottom centre: "in pillager's party" tooltip over "compact smg / fire / use"
findings.what: Two stacked labels in different pill styles overlap the hotbar top edge at y≈925. The key hints "fire" and "use" sit on a lighter tag, with no consistent key-cap style. The party tooltip text is 14px, below the 16px minimum. It also reads as a wrong-case phrase ("pillager's").
findings.fix: Merge into one 16px line card 12px above the hotbar, with key caps drawn as 24px outlined squares. Raise the party text to 16px, or drop it, since the top-left player 1 label already says who is who.

findings.where: Bottom-left status stack: standing, armour 60, stamina, hp 100
findings.what: The bars are different heights and widths, and the labels sit on the fills at 20px. Contrast is poor on the pale blue armour bar, white on light blue at about 2.5:1. The hp number at about 32px is the loudest thing at the bottom-left, while "standing" sits in a separate tilted tab with a different shape.
findings.fix: Use equal 24px bars on an 8px pitch, 440px wide. Set labels in --acc-ink on light fills or move them outside the bar in tx-1. Give "standing" the same square tab shape as the bars, in 16px text.

findings.where: Player markers: "player 1" bar at (90,332) and "p2" tag at (598,627)
findings.what: The two tags use different styles. "player 1" has a blue label plus a bar, and "p2" is a teal box with a thick border. The p2 tag sits on the wall face, half hidden, and it is 5px off its character. Colour assignments for players are still pending his answer, so these should not be re-tinted.
findings.fix: Keep the colours. Match the two tags to one 16px style, 4px radius, 1px border, with a 12px gap under the feet. Do not tint anything new.

findings.what: A small green-bordered chip on dark in a different style from every other pill (green text, border). It sits flush against the screen corner with 8px padding, so it looks like a debug label.
findings.fix: Restyle it with the shared card (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 16px tx-2 text) and 24px margin from the corner, or fold it into the player 1 label.
